function armGlitch(host, wrap): boolean;

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/session.ts:117

Arms the session: builds the overlay canvas against the live wrapper, then races the two render backends — the rust/glitch WebGPU widget mounts first when navigator.gpu exists; anything else claims the 2D context and the painter pipeline (a canvas only allows ONE context mode, so the 2D claim is deferred until the wasm arm fails). Bails quietly when the image isn't decoded, the wrapper is zero-size, or motion is reduced — the remains as the static fallback. Idempotent — returns true when a session is already running.
